'''Mitsuki Saiga''' (Japanese: '''斎賀みつき''' ''Saiga Mitsuki'', born June 12, 1973) is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}} and {{aniseries|HZ}}.

==Biography==
Saiga was born on June 12, 1973 in {{wp|Saitama Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}} and became a voice actress and singer as an adult. Saiga's roles in {{aniseries|PTS}} were of {{an|May}}'s [[rival]] [[Drew]] and [[character of the day]] [[McKenzie]], both of them performed during {{aniseries|RS}}. Saiga is currently affiliated with {{wp|Ken Production}}. She won both Best Supporting Actress Award and Overseas Fan's Award during {{wp|2nd Seiyu Awards}} of 2008 and the {{wp|4th Seiyu Awards}} of 2010, respectively.
